description: Preserve bare mailbox attack delegation and distinguish resettable dev state from authored breakage

replacements.old:
<NOT <MATERIAL-DAMAGE-PRESENT?>>
           <TELL "No authored environmental breakage currently needs a developer reset." CR>)
replacements.new:
<NOT <MATERIAL-RESETTABLE-STATE?>>
           <TELL "No authored environmental breakage or moved test stone currently needs a developer reset." CR>)

replacements.old:

    <COND (<AND <OR <VERB? MUNG CUT ATTACK>
                   <AND <VERB? KICK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>
           <COND (<VERB? KICK>
                  <MATERIAL-REMEMBER-MAILBOX-STATE>

                 (<AND ,PRSI <MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSI>>

                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,KITCHEN-WINDOW>

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MATERIAL-DIRECT-DESTRUCTION-HOOK ()
    <COND (<AND <OR <VERB? MUNG CUT ATTACK>
                   <AND <VERB? KICK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MAILBOX>>
           <COND (<VERB? KICK>
                  <MATERIAL-REMEMBER-MAILBOX-STATE>
                  <COND (<0? ,MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE> <SETG MATERIAL-MAILBOX-DAMAGE 1>)>
                  <TELL "You kick the mailbox hard enough to dent it and immediately receive a detailed report from your foot about the relative hardness of sheet metal." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)
                 (<AND ,PRSI <MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSI>>
                  <MATERIAL-DAMAGE-MAILBOX ,PRSI <>>
                  <RTRUE>)
                 (T <RFALSE>)>)
          (<AND <VERB? MUNG CUT ATTACK>
                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,KITCHEN-WINDOW>
                ,PRSI
                <MATERIAL-DESTRUCTIVE-IMPACT? ,PRSI>>
           <MATERIAL-BREAK-WINDOW ,PRSI>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>
